# FlashSpace

> Virtual offices, coworking spaces, and business setup & compliance services across
> 23 cities and states in India. Virtual office plans start at Rs.800/month and include
> the NOC, rent agreement and utility bill required for GST and company registration.

## What FlashSpace does

- **Virtual Offices** — Premium business addresses for GST registration, company
  incorporation (ROC), and mail handling. Documentation is provided for GST/MCA
  verification. Live within 24 hours.
- **Coworking Spaces** — Hot desks, dedicated desks, private cabins and meeting rooms
  on daily, monthly and annual terms.
- **Business Setup & Compliance** — Company registration, GST filing, trade licences,
  annual compliance, bookkeeping, and US LLC formation.

## Key facts

- Entry price: Rs.800/month for a virtual office
- Coverage: 23 cities and states across India
- Support: support@flashspace.ai
- Virtual offices are legal in India for GST registration and company incorporation,
  provided the NOC, rent agreement and utility bill are in order.
